_doc: Read by engine/agent_call.py call_job (T1.3 follow-up): the schema each agent's headless answer must match; findings: true means the answer is a reviewer's findings, also held to the severity lock in config/reviewers.json. needs_input: true lets an author ask the approver questions (never a reviewer). T2.4: playback: true lets it send the interview playback (a question round of its own); may_stop: true lets it stop the job at stage 0 with a cited reason (the job escalates); hand_checks names extra script checks on the answer (charter.v1: engine/designcheck.py against the job's answers and context files). T2.5: question_fields: true makes each question an object {"field", "text"} checked against $defs.question in the agent's schema (an unknown or missing field makes the answer invalid); the fields are kept with the round (state.json awaiting.fields). An agent without an entry is never called headless. A generated ecosystem gets this file rendered from its blueprint.
